mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id as placeId, p.content_id as contentId, p.name as name, p.address as address, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, p.description as description, ct.content_type_id as contentTypeId, ct.name as contentTypeName FROM place p join content_type ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT img_id as imgId, url FROM place_img WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY img_id ASC

where.if: AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place p join content_type ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id

SELECT p.place_id as placeId, p.content_id as contentId, p.name as name, p.address as address, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, p.description as description, ct.content_type_id as contentTypeId, ct.name as contentTypeName FROM place p join content_type ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id
ORDER BY p.place_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.place_id as placeId, p.content_id as contentId, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.address as address, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, ct.content_type_id as contentTypeId, ct.name as contentTypeName, ROUND((ABS(p.latitude - #{latitude}) + ABS(p.longitude - #{longitude})) * 111, 3) as distanceKm FROM place p join content_type ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id
ORDER BY distanceKm ASC, p.place_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
